text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Bill pay error BP-503 in the mobile app occurs when you try to schedule a payment more than 30 days in the future. The workaround is to schedule the payment from the desktop online banking site instead, which is not affected by the error. Do not delete and reinstall the app, as this does not clear the error. A fix is coming in app release 7.14.", "cited_chunk_ids": ["call_notes_2026_08::layout::B_structure::0000"], "reason": "The supervisor note provides the specific error code, its cause, and the official workaround for this known issue."}
